overloads.semanticRole: Creates (or schedules the creation of) a new log file for the database using the given name or full pathname; passing an empty string prompts the user with a Save File dialog.

discriminatedBy.rule: Pass a Text file name/pathname to create a new log file.

overloads.semanticRole: Closes the current log file for the database when the sentinel '*' parameter is passed instead of a file name.

discriminatedBy.rule: Passing the literal '*' symbol instead of a file name closes the current log file.

constraints: If only a name (not a full pathname) is passed, the file is created in the database's 'Logs' folder next to the structure file.

The new log file is not generated immediately; it takes effect after the next backup (via BACKUP) or a call to New log file, and the pending change persists in the data file even if the database is closed in the meantime.
The OK system variable is set to 1 on success (file created, or closed when '*' is passed) and to 0 if the user cancels the Save File dialog or the log file could not be created.
